_meta.description: Everything under the clearly-trivial line, played as cards (docs/m3-spec.md section 10). Every value is a range and an estimate; the engine personalizes where it can. Only legitimate, within-terms-of-service ideas.
_meta.status: Proposed, not reviewed by Eli. Dollar ranges are placeholders to be checked.

wins.title: Cancel one subscription you forgot about
Switch a monthly subscription to its annual price
Move to a household plan a service offers for families
wins.note: Only where the service's own terms allow a shared household plan.

wins.title: Switch to a lower-cost carrier on the same network
Ask your internet provider for the current new-customer price
Move to an account with no monthly fee
Keep savings in a high-yield account
Turn off overdraft coverage so a fee never happens
Get two quotes for auto insurance
Get a renters insurance quote (or check you are not overpaying)
Use a no-fee cash-back card for the spending you already do
wins.note: Only if the balance is paid in full every month.

wins.title: Join the grocery store's loyalty program
Ask your utility about a budget or off-peak plan
Buy the five things you use most in bulk
Use the library for books, audiobooks, and streaming
Check whether your health plan or employer covers a gym
